content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure—a complete, self-owned system for selling digital products. Unlike platforms that rent you space, this architecture is yours to control. It’s built on free, globally accessible tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and Supabase for order storage. Payments are processed via blockchain, using NOWPayments to accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. This isn’t a patch for Stripe’s absence; it’s a replacement. The system is designed to operate in regions where traditional payment gateways fail. For creators in Ghana, this means no more rejected transactions or frozen accounts. You own the code, the data, and the process. It’s infrastructure designed for resilience, not dependency.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how it functions: Your store lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally fast. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders and trigger file deliveries. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring you retain full data ownership. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both secure and scalable. Payments are verified on-chain using NOWPayments, which sends a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. This system is stateless—no server to manage, no database to maintain. It’s lightweight, cost-effective, and designed to scale. For example, if a customer in Nigeria buys your ebook, the payment is verified on the blockchain, the order is logged in Supabase, and the file is delivered instantly via Cloudflare R2. No middlemen. No delays.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for digital creators in Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, and beyond—anyone locked out of Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software, this infrastructure is your solution. It’s for those who’ve had payments rejected, accounts frozen, or fees eaten by currency fluctuations. It’s for creators who want to own their stack, not rent it. This isn’t a tool for hobbyists; it’s enterprise-grade infrastructure tested in Zimbabwe’s currency collapse and Venezuela’s financial isolation. It’s for creators who value sovereignty over convenience. If you’re tired of being blocked by geographic restrictions, this is how you take control. It’s not just a payment solution—it’s a business architecture.
Blockchain payments remove geographic restrictions entirely.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is modular but integrated. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic uses Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring fast, serverless execution. Order storage is managed by Supabase (a PostgreSQL database) or Google Sheets, depending on your needs. File delivery is via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both secure and scalable. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. The system is configured with SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability and end-to-end tested for reliability. Each component is chosen for its cost-effectiveness, scalability, and global accessibility. Together, they form a stack that’s not just functional but future-proof.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197)—it’s deployed in 48 hours, fully configured, and ready to sell. You get Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Five products are loaded for you, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC are set up for email reliability. If you prefer to build it yourself, grab the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for full documentation and source code. Either way, you’ll own the infrastructure after deployment. No subscriptions. No ongoing fees. Just a one-time investment in your business. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution. Deploy today, and start selling globally without geographic restrictions.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you, fully configured. You don’t need to write code or manage servers. It’s designed for creators, not developers.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay ongoing fees?
No. After deployment, you own the infrastructure. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% per transaction. No subscriptions or hidden costs.
Can I scale this as my business grows?
Yes. The stack is built on scalable components like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase. It’s designed to handle growth without additional costs.
What if I need support after deployment?
The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30 days of support. For ongoing assistance, you can purchase additional support packages or use the documentation provided.
